messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} you know
today's {ff 00 00 03}La-Di-Day{ff 00 00 00}, right?
You ready for some music?
Because we're all trying to
get our song chosen to be
the new town tune.
{07 15 00}Remember, the whole town
has to listen to whatever
you pick, so make it good!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} sa tead, et
täna on {ff 00 00 03}laulupäev{ff 00 00 00}, eks?
Oled sa muusikaks valmis?
Sest me kõik üritame saada
oma laulu uueks
linna viisiks.
{07 15 00}Pea meeles, terve linn peab
kuulama seda, mida sa
valid, nii et vali hästi!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}It's {ff 00 00 03}La-Di-Day{ff 00 00 00} today,
{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}and I've been
practicing all week.
{07 00 00}Of course, getting my song
picked as the town tune is
just the first step.
{07 0d 00}Next, {01 00 00 05 00}I'm gonna get myself
a record deal and become
a superstar, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Täna on {ff 00 00 03}laulupäev{ff 00 00 00},
{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}ja ma olen
terve nädala harjutanud.
{07 00 00}Muidugi on mu laulu
valimine linna viisiks
alles esimene samm.
{07 0d 00}Järgmisena {01 00 00 05 00}hangin ma
plaadilepingu ja saan
superstaariks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Been
warming up your vocal
chords for {ff 00 00 03}La-Di-Day{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 14 00}I've been composing songs
all week.{01 00 00 05 00} I want mine
picked for the town tune!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tere, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Oled sa
oma häälepaelu
{ff 00 00 03}laulupäevaks{ff 00 00 00} soojendanud?
{07 14 00}Ma olen terve nädala laule
loonud.{01 00 00 05 00} Tahan, et minu oma
valitaks linna viisiks!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I don't know if you're a fan
of singing, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00}
but I was wondering{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0b 00}Would you listen to my
song? I want to get your
opinion, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma ei tea, kas sa oled
laulmise fänn, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00}
aga ma mõtlesin{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0b 00}Kas sa kuulaksid mu
laulu? Ma tahaksin su
arvamust, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}My mom thinks I should
have been a singer. She
says I have a lovely voice.
{07 0b 00}Would you care for a little
live concert, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mu ema arvab, et ma
oleksin pidanud lauljaks
saama. Mul olevat ilus hääl.
{07 0b 00}Kas sa sooviksid väikest
elavat kontserti, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}{00 01 00}Mi mi mi meee! La la la!{00 01 00}


{07 14 00}I'm all warmed up,
{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Here, listen
to the song I wrote!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}{00 01 00}Mi mi mi miii! La la la!{00 01 00}


{07 14 00}Ma olen soojendatud,
{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Kuula, see on
laul, mille ma kirjutasin!

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}Oooog{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00} I sorta blew it
there in the middle, didn't
I, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
But it was still pretty
fabulous, wasn't it?{01 01 00}
Tell me it was fabulous!
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}Ohoo{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00} Ma vist rikkusin
selle keskel ära, eks
ole, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Aga ikkagi oli see päris
vapustav, kas polnud?{01 01 00}
Ütle, et oli vapustav!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I thought I was going to be
shy singing in front of
you, but I did all right!
{07 0b 00}It was pretty good, don't
you think, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma arvasin, et mul on su
ees laulda häbi, aga
mul läks päris hästi!
{07 0b 00}See oli päris hea, kas sa
ei arva, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Oh, that's so awesome! I'm
so happy it turned out
all right, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}All that singing in the
shower has finally paid
off, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Oh, see on nii vahva! Ma
olen nii õnnelik, et see
hästi välja tuli, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Kogu see duši all laulmine
on lõpuks vilja
kandnud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 1d 00}Are you serious? {01 00 00 05 00}Oh, man,
that's no good, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}It's because I warbled,
isn't it? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 08 00}I can't help it if
I'm a warbler!
{07 00 00}I'm sorry. I'm being silly.{07 14 00}
Actually, I like warbling.
And yodeling, too.
messages.et:
{07 1d 00}Kas sa tõsiselt? {01 00 00 05 00}Oh, oi,
see pole hea, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}See on sellepärast, et ma
trillerdasin, eks? {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 08 00}Ma ei saa
parata, et olen trillerdaja!
{07 00 00}Vabandust. Ma olen rumal.{07 14 00}
Tegelikult mulle meeldib
trillerdada. Ja jodeldada.

messages.en:
{07 0f 00}Oh, no! Does this mean the
judges are going to vote
me out of the village?
messages.et:
{07 0f 00}Oh ei! Kas see tähendab, et
kohtunikud hääletavad mu
külast välja?

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I see the way it is. Yeah, I
got that loud and clear,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma näen, kuidas on. Jah, ma
sain sellest valjult ja
selgelt aru, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Singing well is all about
good breathing technique.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hästi laulmine sõltub
kõigest heast hingamisest.

messages.en:
The key to singing well is
to project from your
abdomen, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Your belly is a spotlight,
{04 1f 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}And you must
shine it on your audience!
messages.et:
Hea laulmise võti on
hääle saatmine
kõhust, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Su kõht on prožektor,
{04 1f 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}Ja pead sellega
publikut valgustama!

{07 14 00}Hi hii!{01 00 00 05 00} Nii, {04 1f 00},
kas sa naudid kogu seda
muusikat, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}There's nothing I love so
much as live music.

{07 00 00}But that's beside the point.
Was there something you
wanted, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Miski ei meeldi mulle nii
väga kui elav muusika.

{07 00 00}Aga see pole praegu oluline.
Kas sa tahtsid midagi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Heard anything you like
today? Does anyone else
have a decent song?
{07 00 00}No, don't tell me. I'll find
out later. {01 00 00 05 00}So, did you need
something, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kuulsid täna midagi, mis
meeldis? Kas kellelgi
teisel on korralik laul?
{07 00 00}Ei, ära ütle. Ma saan
hiljem teada. {01 00 00 05 00}Nii, kas sul
oli midagi vaja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
